blocks.text: A Private Healing Experience for One or Two
blocks.html: A Private Healing Experience for One or Two

A herbal bath at Elements Wellness is a therapeutic ritual deeply rooted in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). As the warm water opens your pores, the infused herbs work to soothe tired muscles, calm the mind, detox the body, and nourish the skin.

Enjoy complete privacy in a room with two individual tubs — ideal for couples or friends. Each person selects a personalized herbal blend to match their wellness needs. Coming solo is just as meaningful. In today’s busy world, taking time to care for your body and mind is a powerful act of self-care.

blocks.text: What Makes Our Herbal Bath Therapy Unique?
blocks.html: What Makes Our Herbal Bath Therapy Unique?

Our Herbal Bath Therapy is not just relaxing — it’s therapeutic and rooted in TCM wisdom.
What sets us apart is the variety of our herbal formulas. With targeted blends to support sleep, circulation, fertility, detoxification, hormonal balance, and more, we’re able to address wellness concerns while you relax fully. As you soak in the warm infusion, the benefits are absorbed through the skin to restore your body from within
Our Signature Herbal Blends:

• Insomnia Relief
  • Muscle Recovery and Circulation
  • Detox and Weight Loss
  • Men’s Fertility and Vitality (Men only)
  • Uterus warming and dampness removing (women only)
